## 4. LLM (бесплатный анонимный эндпоинт)

```
POST https://text.pollinations.ai/openai
Content-Type: application/json
{"model": "openai", "messages": [...], "temperature": 0.2}
```
(`llm_pollinations_response.json`, `llm_pollinations_letsplay_9k.json`)

- Ответ в формате OpenAI chat.completion: `choices[0].message.content`, плюс `choices[0].message.reasoning`
  (рассуждения модели, игнорировать), `finish_reason`, `usage`, `model`, `user_tier: "anonymous"`.
- `"model":"openai"` на деле обслуживает **`gpt-oss-20b`** (reasoning-модель), так что рассуждения съедают
  completion-токены: на 131 токен промпта пришлось 444 токена ответа.
- Задержка от 7.7 до 17.2 с: 10.2 с на маленький JSON-промпт, 7.7 с на 6 354 символа расшифровки (1693 токена),
  17.2 с на вопрос в одно слово. Время ответа сильно плавает, заголовков rate-limit нет.
- Подвохи: (1) JSON возвращается внутри ```` ```json ... ``` ````, ограждение надо снимать перед `json.loads`;
  (2) без явной инструкции модель пишет от первого лица блогера и пересказывает спонсорскую вставку, поэтому
  в промпте нужно «в третьем лице, игнорируй рекламу и просьбы подписаться»; (3) расшифровку в 50 тыс. символов
  целиком не отправлять: брать 3 куска (начало, середина, конец) общим объёмом ≤ 8–9 тыс. символов или делать
  map-reduce с паузами.
- Вызовы строго последовательные, пауза 3–5 с, 3 ретрая с backoff, таймаут 120 с. При неудаче строится
  экстрактивное резюме (самые частые содержательные фразы из positive/negative отзывов), в БД пишется
  `summary_method = "llm" | "extractive"`.
- Настройки через env `LLM_BASE_URL` (по умолчанию `https://text.pollinations.ai/openai`), `LLM_API_KEY`
  (по умолчанию пустой, заголовок `Authorization` тогда не отправлять), `LLM_MODEL` (по умолчанию `openai`).
  Работают оба адреса, `…/openai` и `…/openai/chat/completions` (проверено, оба 200), поэтому подходит
  стандартная схема OpenAI-клиентов «base_url + `/chat/completions`».

Сторонний API не нужен: всё есть в `product`. Это `genres[].name`, `gameTaxonomy.franchises[].name`,

import time

from app.similarity import GameFeatures, compute_similar, tokenize


def make_games():
    return [
        GameFeatures(1, "Star Wars: Galactic Racer", "High speed podracing across the galaxy with boost and drift.",
                     ["Future Racing"], ["Star Wars"], ["Fuse Games"], ["PC", "PlayStation 5"]),
        GameFeatures(2, "Star Wars Episode I: Racer", "Classic podracing on Tatooine at blistering speed.",
                     ["Future Racing"], ["Star Wars"], ["LucasArts"], ["PC"]),
        GameFeatures(3, "Planet Zoo 2", "Build and manage a zoo, care for animals and design habitats.",
                     ["Management"], [], ["Frontier"], ["PC"]),
        GameFeatures(4, "Planet Coaster 3", "Build theme parks, design roller coasters and manage guests.",
                     ["Management"], [], ["Frontier"], ["PC"]),
        GameFeatures(5, "Gears of War: E-Day", "Brutal third-person cover shooter against the Locust horde.",
                     ["Third-Person Shooter"], ["Gears of War"], ["The Coalition"], ["Xbox Series X", "PC"]),
    ]


def test_franchise_and_developer_matches_rank_first():
    sim = compute_similar(make_games(), top_n=5)
    assert sim[1][0]["id"] == 2
    assert "та же франшиза" in sim[1][0]["reasons"]
    assert sim[3][0]["id"] == 4
    assert "тот же разработчик" in sim[3][0]["reasons"]


def test_self_excluded_and_top_n_respected():
    sim = compute_similar(make_games(), top_n=2)
    for gid, lst in sim.items():
        assert gid not in [x["id"] for x in lst]
        assert len(lst) <= 2
        scores = [x["score"] for x in lst]
        assert scores == sorted(scores, reverse=True)


def test_unrelated_game_may_have_no_matches_and_small_db():
    sim = compute_similar(make_games())
    assert all(x["id"] != 5 for x in sim[3])
    assert compute_similar(make_games()[:1]) == {1: []}


def test_tokenize_drops_stopwords():
    toks = tokenize("The game features new worlds and racing races")
    assert "the" not in toks and "game" not in toks
    assert "racing" in toks and "race" in toks


def test_scales_to_a_few_thousand_games():
    genres = ["Action", "RPG", "Racing", "Puzzle", "Strategy", "Shooter"]
    words = "dragon sword space ship race car puzzle tower city build farm zombie ninja robot magic castle".split()
    games = [GameFeatures(i, f"Game {i}", " ".join(words[(i * k) % len(words)] for k in range(1, 12)),
                          [genres[i % len(genres)]], [], [f"Studio {i % 300}"], ["PC"]) for i in range(1500)]
    t = time.time()
    sim = compute_similar(games)
    assert len(sim) == 1500
    assert time.time() - t < 60

import json
import logging
import os
import queue
import sqlite3
import threading
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from .config import iso, utcnow
from .metacritic import GameDetails

log = logging.getLogger("db")

BASE_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS games (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    title_search TEXT NOT NULL,
    release_date TEXT,
    description TEXT,
    developers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    publishers TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    genres TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    franchises TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    rating TEXT,
    cover_url TEXT,
    hero_url TEXT,
    video_embed_url TEXT,
    video_manifest_url TEXT,
    video_title TEXT,
    lead_platform TEXT,
    metascore INTEGER,
    userscore REAL,
    critic_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    user_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    critic_reviews TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    user_reviews TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    critic_summary TEXT,
    user_summary TEXT,
    letsplay TEXT,
    similar TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    source TEXT,
    first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    times_processed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_games_metascore ON games(metascore);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_games_userscore ON games(userscore);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_games_release ON games(release_date);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS platforms (
    game_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES games(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    short TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_lead INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    metascore INTEGER,
    critic_count INTEGER,
    userscore REAL,
    user_count INTEGER,
    release_date TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (game_id, slug)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_platforms_name ON platforms(name);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS day_state (
    day TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    new_releases_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    browse_offset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS processed (
    day TEXT NOT NULL,
    game_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT,
    run_id INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    source TEXT,
    processed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (day, game_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    trigger TEXT NOT NULL,
    day TEXT NOT NULL,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    selected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ok INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    failed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    sources TEXT,
    message TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS errors (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    run_id INTEGER,
    day TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT,
    step TEXT,
    message TEXT NOT NULL,
    at TEXT NOT NULL
);
"""

MIGRATIONS: list[list[str]] = [
    [
        "ALTER TABLE processed ADD COLUMN attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1",
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_processed_day_status ON processed(day, status)",
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_errors_day ON errors(day)",
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_errors_at ON errors(at)",
    ],
    [
        "ALTER TABLE runs ADD COLUMN owner TEXT",
        "ALTER TABLE runs ADD COLUMN heartbeat_at TEXT",
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_runs_status ON runs(status)",
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_runs_day_trigger ON runs(day, trigger)",
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leases (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, "
        "acquired_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)",
    ],
    [
        "ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN backfill_at TEXT",
        "ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN backfill_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0",
    ],
    [
        "ALTER TABLE games ADD COLUMN trailer TEXT",
    ],
]

SCHEMA_VERSION = len(MIGRATIONS)

SORTS = {
    "metascore_desc": ("score_meta", "DESC"),
    "metascore_asc": ("score_meta", "ASC"),
    "userscore_desc": ("score_user", "DESC"),
    "userscore_asc": ("score_user", "ASC"),
    "date_desc": ("g.release_date", "DESC"),
    "date_asc": ("g.release_date", "ASC"),
    "title": ("g.title_search", "ASC"),
    "updated": ("g.updated_at", "DESC"),
}

JSON_FIELDS = ("developers", "publishers", "genres", "franchises", "critic_reviews", "user_reviews",
               "critic_summary", "user_summary", "letsplay", "similar", "trailer")
JSON_COLUMNS = ("critic_summary", "user_summary", "letsplay", "similar", "trailer")


@dataclass
class DayState:
    day: str
    new_releases_done: bool = False
    browse_offset: int = 0


def _dumps(v) -> str:
    return json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False)


def search_key(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join((text or "").casefold().split())


def like_escape(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


class SchemaTooNew(RuntimeError):
    pass


def migrate(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        version = conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
        if version > SCHEMA_VERSION:
            raise SchemaTooNew(f"database schema v{version} is newer than this code (v{SCHEMA_VERSION})")
        if version == 0:
            for statement in BASE_SCHEMA.split(";"):
                if statement.strip():
                    conn.execute(statement)
        for number in range(version + 1, SCHEMA_VERSION + 1):
            for statement in MIGRATIONS[number - 1]:
                conn.execute(statement)
            conn.execute(f"PRAGMA user_version = {number}")
            log.info("Database migrated to schema v%d", number)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    return conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]


class Database:
    def __init__(self, path: str, pool_size: int = 8):
        self.path = path
        self.memory = path == ":memory:"
        if not self.memory:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)
        self.pool_size = 1 if self.memory else max(1, pool_size)
        self._idle: queue.LifoQueue = queue.LifoQueue()
        self._slots = threading.BoundedSemaphore(self.pool_size)
        self._all: list[sqlite3.Connection] = []
        self._all_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._write_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._closed = False
        boot = self._connect(autocommit=True)
        try:
            self.schema_version = migrate(boot)
        finally:
            if self.memory:
                boot.isolation_level = ""
                self._register(boot)
                self._idle.put(boot)
            else:
                boot.close()

    def _connect(self, autocommit: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=30, check_same_thread=False,
                               isolation_level=None if autocommit else "")
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
        if not self.memory:
            conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
            conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        return conn

    def _register(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
        with self._all_lock:
            self._all.append(conn)

    @property
    def open_connections(self) -> int:
        with self._all_lock:
            return len(self._all)

    @contextmanager
    def conn(self):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("database is closed")
        self._slots.acquire()
        try:
            try:
                conn = self._idle.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                conn = self._connect()
                self._register(conn)
            try:
                yield conn
                conn.commit()
            except BaseException:
                conn.rollback()
                raise
            finally:
                self._idle.put(conn)
        finally:
            self._slots.release()

    @contextmanager
    def write(self):
        with self._write_lock, self.conn() as c:
            yield c

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._closed = True
        with self._all_lock:
            conns, self._all = self._all, []
        for c in conns:
            try:
                c.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def get_day_state(self, day: str) -> DayState:
        with self.conn() as c:
            row = c.execute("SELECT * FROM day_state WHERE day=?", (day,)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            return DayState(day=day)
        return DayState(day=day, new_releases_done=bool(row["new_releases_done"]), browse_offset=row["browse_offset"])

    def save_day_state(self, state: DayState) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO day_state(day, new_releases_done, browse_offset, updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(day) DO UPDATE SET new_releases_done=excluded.new_releases_done, "
                "browse_offset=excluded.browse_offset, updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
                (state.day, int(state.new_releases_done), state.browse_offset, iso(utcnow())),
            )

    def processed_ids(self, day: str, max_attempts: int = 1) -> set[int]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return {r[0] for r in c.execute(
                "SELECT game_id FROM processed WHERE day=? AND (status != 'error' OR attempts >= ?)",
                (day, max_attempts))}

    def retry_candidates(self, day: str, max_attempts: int) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
                "SELECT game_id, slug, title, source, attempts FROM processed "
                "WHERE day=? AND status='error' AND attempts < ? ORDER BY processed_at", (day, max_attempts))]

    def mark_processed(self, day: str, game_id: int, slug: str, title: str, run_id: int | None, status: str,
                       source: str) -> int:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO processed(day, game_id, slug, title, run_id, status, source, processed_at, attempts) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1) ON CONFLICT(day, game_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status, "
                "run_id=excluded.run_id, processed_at=excluded.processed_at, attempts=processed.attempts+1",
                (day, game_id, slug, title, run_id, status, source, iso(utcnow())),
            )
            return c.execute("SELECT attempts FROM processed WHERE day=? AND game_id=?", (day, game_id)).fetchone()[0]

    def processed_count(self, day: str, status: str | None = None) -> int:
        with self.conn() as c:
            if status:
                return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM processed WHERE day=? AND status=?", (day, status)).fetchone()[0]
            return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM processed WHERE day=?", (day,)).fetchone()[0]

    def upsert_game(self, g: GameDetails, source: str) -> bool:
        now = iso(utcnow())
        with self.write() as c:
            exists = c.execute("SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE id=?", (g.id,)).fetchone() is not None
            if not exists:
                clash = c.execute("SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug=?", (g.slug,)).fetchone()
                if clash:
                    log.info("Slug %s moved from game %s to %s, replacing the old row", g.slug, clash[0], g.id)
                    c.execute("DELETE FROM games WHERE id=?", (clash[0],))
            values = {
                "id": g.id,
                "slug": g.slug,
                "title": g.title,
                "title_search": search_key(g.title),
                "release_date": g.release_date,
                "description": g.description,
                "developers": _dumps(g.developers),
                "publishers": _dumps(g.publishers),
                "genres": _dumps(g.genres),
                "franchises": _dumps(g.franchises),
                "rating": g.rating,
                "cover_url": g.cover_url,
                "hero_url": g.hero_url,
                "video_embed_url": g.video_embed_url,
                "video_manifest_url": g.video_manifest_url,
                "video_title": g.video_title,
                "lead_platform": g.lead_platform,
                "metascore": g.metascore,
                "userscore": g.userscore,
                "critic_total": g.critic_total,
                "user_total": g.user_total,
                "critic_reviews": _dumps([r.to_dict() for r in g.critic_reviews]),
                "user_reviews": _dumps([r.to_dict() for r in g.user_reviews]),
                "source": source,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            if exists:
                sets = ", ".join(f"{k}=:{k}" for k in values if k != "id")
                c.execute(f"UPDATE games SET {sets}, times_processed=times_processed+1 WHERE id=:id", values)
            else:
                values["first_seen_at"] = now
                values["times_processed"] = 1
                cols = ", ".join(values)
                c.execute(f"INSERT INTO games({cols}) VALUES ({', '.join(':' + k for k in values)})", values)
            c.execute("DELETE FROM platforms WHERE game_id=?", (g.id,))
            c.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO platforms(game_id, slug, name, short, is_lead, metascore, critic_count, userscore, "
                "user_count, release_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                [
                    (g.id, p.slug, p.name, p.short, int(p.is_lead), p.metascore, p.critic_count, p.userscore,
                     p.user_count, p.release_date)
                    for p in g.platforms
                ],
            )
        return not exists

    def set_json(self, game_id: int, column: str, value) -> None:
        if column not in JSON_COLUMNS:
            raise ValueError(column)
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute(f"UPDATE games SET {column}=? WHERE id=?", (_dumps(value), game_id))

    def mark_backfill_attempt(self, game_id: int) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE games SET backfill_at=?, backfill_attempts=backfill_attempts+1 WHERE id=?",
                      (iso(utcnow()), game_id))

    def set_similar_bulk(self, mapping: dict[int, list[dict]]) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.executemany("UPDATE games SET similar=? WHERE id=?", [(_dumps(v), k) for k, v in mapping.items()])

    @staticmethod
    def _row_to_game(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
        g = dict(row)
        for f in JSON_FIELDS:
            if f in g:
                g[f] = json.loads(g[f]) if g[f] else ([] if f in ("similar",) else None)
        return g

    def get_game(self, slug: str | None = None, game_id: int | None = None) -> dict | None:
        with self.conn() as c:
            if slug is not None:

            else:
                row = c.execute("SELECT * FROM games WHERE id=?", (game_id,)).fetchone()
            if not row:
                return None
            g = self._row_to_game(row)
            g["platforms"] = [dict(p) for p in c.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM platforms WHERE game_id=? ORDER BY is_lead DESC, name", (g["id"],))]
        return g

    def games_with_fallbacks(self, limit: int) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:

                "SELECT id, slug, title, critic_summary, user_summary, letsplay, critic_reviews, user_reviews, "
                "backfill_at, backfill_attempts FROM games "
                "WHERE json_extract(critic_summary, '$.method') = 'extractive' "
                "OR json_extract(user_summary, '$.method') = 'extractive' "
                "OR (json_extract(letsplay, '$.method') = 'extractive-transcript' "
                "    AND json_extract(letsplay, '$.transcript_excerpt') IS NOT NULL) "
                "OR (json_extract(letsplay, '$.method') = 'description' "
                "    AND json_extract(letsplay, '$.video.description') IS NOT NULL) "
                "ORDER BY backfill_at IS NOT NULL, backfill_at, updated_at DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()

                f"SELECT id, slug, title, cover_url, metascore, userscore, release_date FROM games WHERE id IN ({q})",

            ).fetchall()
        return {r["id"]: dict(r) for r in rows}

    def list_games(self, q: str | None = None, platform: str | None = None, sort: str = "date_desc",
                   limit: int = 24, offset: int = 0) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
        sort_col, direction = SORTS.get(sort, SORTS["date_desc"])
        params: list = []
        join = ""
        meta_expr, user_expr = "g.metascore", "g.userscore"
        if platform:
            join = "JOIN platforms p ON p.game_id = g.id AND p.name = ?"
            params.append(platform)
            meta_expr, user_expr = "p.metascore", "p.userscore"
        where = ""
        if q and search_key(q):
            where = "WHERE g.title_search LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'"
            params.append(f"%{like_escape(search_key(q))}%")
        base = f"FROM games g {join} {where}"
        order = f"{sort_col} IS NULL, {sort_col} {direction}, g.release_date DESC, g.id DESC"
        sql = (

            f"g.updated_at, {meta_expr} AS score_meta, {user_expr} AS score_user {base} ORDER BY {order} LIMIT ? OFFSET ?"
        )
        with self.conn() as c:
            total = c.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) {base}", params).fetchone()[0]
            rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(sql, params + [limit, offset])]
            ids = [r["id"] for r in rows]
            plats: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}

                qmarks = ",".join("?" * len(ids))
                for p in c.execute(

    def heartbeat_run(self, run_id: int, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:

    def close_stale_runs(self, now: datetime | None = None, ttl_seconds: int = 90) -> int:
        now = now or utcnow()
        threshold = iso(now - timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds))
        with self.write() as c:
            cur = c.execute(
                "UPDATE runs SET status='interrupted', finished_at=?, "
                "message=COALESCE(NULLIF(message, ''), 'Процесс остановился посреди запуска') "
                "WHERE status='running' AND COALESCE(heartbeat_at, started_at) < ?",
                (iso(now), threshold))
            return cur.rowcount

    def recent_runs(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))]

    def last_run(self) -> dict | None:
        runs = self.recent_runs(1)
        return runs[0] if runs else None

    def last_finished_at(self) -> str | None:
        with self.conn() as c:
            row = c.execute("SELECT MAX(finished_at) FROM runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL").fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

    def count_runs(self, day: str, trigger: str) -> int:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE day=? AND trigger=?", (day, trigger)).fetchone()[0]

    def add_error(self, run_id: int | None, day: str, slug: str | None, step: str, message: str) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO errors(run_id, day, slug, step, message, at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                      (run_id, day, slug, step, message[:500], iso(utcnow())))

    def error_count(self, day: str | None = None) -> int:
        with self.conn() as c:
            if day:
                return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM errors WHERE day=?", (day,)).fetchone()[0]
            return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM errors").fetchone()[0]

    def recent_errors(self, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM errors ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))]

    def prune(self, now: datetime, errors_keep_days: int, processed_keep_days: int) -> dict:
        errors_before = iso(now - timedelta(days=errors_keep_days))
        processed_before = (now - timedelta(days=processed_keep_days)).date().isoformat()
        with self.write() as c:
            e = c.execute("DELETE FROM errors WHERE at < ?", (errors_before,)).rowcount
            p = c.execute("DELETE FROM processed WHERE day < ?", (processed_before,)).rowcount
            d = c.execute("DELETE FROM day_state WHERE day < ?", (processed_before,)).rowcount
        return {"errors": e, "processed": p, "day_state": d}

    def acquire_lease(self, name: str, owner: str, ttl_seconds: int, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
        now = now or utcnow()
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO leases(name, owner, acquired_at, expires_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET owner=excluded.owner, acquired_at=excluded.acquired_at, "
                "expires_at=excluded.expires_at WHERE leases.expires_at < ? OR leases.owner = excluded.owner",
                (name, owner, iso(now), iso(now + timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)), iso(now)))
            row = c.execute("SELECT owner FROM leases WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
        return bool(row) and row[0] == owner

    def renew_lease(self, name: str, owner: str, ttl_seconds: int, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
        now = now or utcnow()
        with self.write() as c:
            cur = c.execute("UPDATE leases SET expires_at=? WHERE name=? AND owner=?",
                            (iso(now + timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)), name, owner))
            return cur.rowcount == 1

    def release_lease(self, name: str, owner: str) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("DELETE FROM leases WHERE name=? AND owner=?", (name, owner))

    def lease_holder(self, name: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> str | None:
        now = now or utcnow()
        with self.conn() as c:
            row = c.execute("SELECT owner FROM leases WHERE name=? AND expires_at >= ?", (name, iso(now))).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

def _dumps(v) -> str:

def search_key(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join((text or "").casefold().split())


def like_escape(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


class SchemaTooNew(RuntimeError):
    pass


def migrate(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:
    conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        version = conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]
        if version > SCHEMA_VERSION:
            raise SchemaTooNew(f"database schema v{version} is newer than this code (v{SCHEMA_VERSION})")
        if version == 0:
            for statement in BASE_SCHEMA.split(";"):
                if statement.strip():
                    conn.execute(statement)
        for number in range(version + 1, SCHEMA_VERSION + 1):
            for statement in MIGRATIONS[number - 1]:
                conn.execute(statement)
            conn.execute(f"PRAGMA user_version = {number}")
            log.info("Database migrated to schema v%d", number)
        conn.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        conn.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    return conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]


class Database:
    def __init__(self, path: str, pool_size: int = 8):
        self.path = path
        self.memory = path == ":memory:"
        if not self.memory:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), exist_ok=True)
        self.pool_size = 1 if self.memory else max(1, pool_size)
        self._idle: queue.LifoQueue = queue.LifoQueue()
        self._slots = threading.BoundedSemaphore(self.pool_size)
        self._all: list[sqlite3.Connection] = []
        self._all_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._write_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._closed = False
        boot = self._connect(autocommit=True)
        try:
            self.schema_version = migrate(boot)
        finally:
            if self.memory:
                boot.isolation_level = ""
                self._register(boot)
                self._idle.put(boot)
            else:
                boot.close()

    def _connect(self, autocommit: bool = False) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=30, check_same_thread=False,
                               isolation_level=None if autocommit else "")
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
        if not self.memory:
            conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
            conn.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")
        return conn

    def _register(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
        with self._all_lock:
            self._all.append(conn)

    @property
    def open_connections(self) -> int:
        with self._all_lock:
            return len(self._all)

    @contextmanager
    def conn(self):
        if self._closed:
            raise RuntimeError("database is closed")
        self._slots.acquire()
        try:
            try:
                conn = self._idle.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                conn = self._connect()
                self._register(conn)
            try:
                yield conn
                conn.commit()
            except BaseException:
                conn.rollback()
                raise
            finally:
                self._idle.put(conn)
        finally:
            self._slots.release()

    @contextmanager
    def write(self):
        with self._write_lock, self.conn() as c:
            yield c

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._closed = True
        with self._all_lock:
            conns, self._all = self._all, []
        for c in conns:
            try:
                c.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def get_day_state(self, day: str) -> DayState:

        return DayState(day=day, new_releases_done=bool(row["new_releases_done"]), browse_offset=row["browse_offset"])

                    log.info("Slug %s moved from game %s to %s, replacing the old row", g.slug, clash[0], g.id)

                "source": source,

            }
            if exists:

            else:

            c.execute("DELETE FROM platforms WHERE game_id=?", (g.id,))
            c.executemany(

                "user_count, release_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                [
                    (g.id, p.slug, p.name, p.short, int(p.is_lead), p.metascore, p.critic_count, p.userscore,
                     p.user_count, p.release_date)
                    for p in g.platforms
                ],
            )
        return not exists

    def set_json(self, game_id: int, column: str, value) -> None:
        if column not in JSON_COLUMNS:
            raise ValueError(column)
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute(f"UPDATE games SET {column}=? WHERE id=?", (_dumps(value), game_id))

    def mark_backfill_attempt(self, game_id: int) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE games SET backfill_at=?, backfill_attempts=backfill_attempts+1 WHERE id=?",
                      (iso(utcnow()), game_id))

    def set_similar_bulk(self, mapping: dict[int, list[dict]]) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.executemany("UPDATE games SET similar=? WHERE id=?", [(_dumps(v), k) for k, v in mapping.items()])

    @staticmethod
    def _row_to_game(row: sqlite3.Row) -> dict:
        g = dict(row)
        for f in JSON_FIELDS:
            if f in g:
                g[f] = json.loads(g[f]) if g[f] else ([] if f in ("similar",) else None)
        return g

    def get_game(self, slug: str | None = None, game_id: int | None = None) -> dict | None:
        with self.conn() as c:
            if slug is not None:
                row = c.execute("SELECT * FROM games WHERE slug=?", (slug,)).fetchone()
            else:
                row = c.execute("SELECT * FROM games WHERE id=?", (game_id,)).fetchone()
            if not row:
                return None
            g = self._row_to_game(row)
            g["platforms"] = [dict(p) for p in c.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM platforms WHERE game_id=? ORDER BY is_lead DESC, name", (g["id"],))]
        return g

    def games_with_fallbacks(self, limit: int) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            rows = c.execute(
                "SELECT id, slug, title, critic_summary, user_summary, letsplay, critic_reviews, user_reviews, "
                "backfill_at, backfill_attempts FROM games "
                "WHERE json_extract(critic_summary, '$.method') = 'extractive' "
                "OR json_extract(user_summary, '$.method') = 'extractive' "
                "OR (json_extract(letsplay, '$.method') = 'extractive-transcript' "
                "    AND json_extract(letsplay, '$.transcript_excerpt') IS NOT NULL) "
                "OR (json_extract(letsplay, '$.method') = 'description' "
                "    AND json_extract(letsplay, '$.video.description') IS NOT NULL) "
                "ORDER BY backfill_at IS NOT NULL, backfill_at, updated_at DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,)).fetchall()
        return [self._row_to_game(r) for r in rows]

    def all_features(self) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            rows = c.execute("SELECT id, title, description, genres, franchises, developers FROM games").fetchall()
            plats: dict[int, list[str]] = {}
            for p in c.execute("SELECT game_id, name FROM platforms"):
                plats.setdefault(p[0], []).append(p[1])
        return [
            {
                "id": r["id"],
                "title": r["title"],
                "description": r["description"] or "",
                "genres": json.loads(r["genres"]),
                "franchises": json.loads(r["franchises"]),
                "developers": json.loads(r["developers"]),
                "platforms": plats.get(r["id"], []),
            }
            for r in rows
        ]

    def brief_games(self, ids: list[int]) -> dict[int, dict]:
        if not ids:
            return {}
        with self.conn() as c:
            q = ",".join("?" * len(ids))
            rows = c.execute(
                f"SELECT id, slug, title, cover_url, metascore, userscore, release_date FROM games WHERE id IN ({q})",
                ids,
            ).fetchall()
        return {r["id"]: dict(r) for r in rows}

    def list_games(self, q: str | None = None, platform: str | None = None, sort: str = "date_desc",
                   limit: int = 24, offset: int = 0) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
        sort_col, direction = SORTS.get(sort, SORTS["date_desc"])
        params: list = []
        join = ""
        meta_expr, user_expr = "g.metascore", "g.userscore"
        if platform:
            join = "JOIN platforms p ON p.game_id = g.id AND p.name = ?"
            params.append(platform)
            meta_expr, user_expr = "p.metascore", "p.userscore"
        where = ""
        if q and search_key(q):
            where = "WHERE g.title_search LIKE ? ESCAPE '\\'"
            params.append(f"%{like_escape(search_key(q))}%")
        base = f"FROM games g {join} {where}"
        order = f"{sort_col} IS NULL, {sort_col} {direction}, g.release_date DESC, g.id DESC"
        sql = (
            f"SELECT g.id, g.slug, g.title, g.cover_url, g.release_date, g.developers, g.genres, g.lead_platform, "
            f"g.updated_at, {meta_expr} AS score_meta, {user_expr} AS score_user {base} ORDER BY {order} LIMIT ? OFFSET ?"
        )
        with self.conn() as c:
            total = c.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) {base}", params).fetchone()[0]
            rows = [dict(r) for r in c.execute(sql, params + [limit, offset])]
            ids = [r["id"] for r in rows]
            plats: dict[int, list[dict]] = {}
            if ids:
                qmarks = ",".join("?" * len(ids))
                for p in c.execute(
                    f"SELECT game_id, name, short, metascore, userscore, is_lead FROM platforms "
                    f"WHERE game_id IN ({qmarks}) ORDER BY is_lead DESC, name", ids):
                    plats.setdefault(p["game_id"], []).append(dict(p))
        for r in rows:
            r["developers"] = json.loads(r["developers"])
            r["genres"] = json.loads(r["genres"])
            r["platforms"] = plats.get(r["id"], [])
        return rows, total

    def platform_options(self) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return [dict(r) for r in c.execute(
                "SELECT name, MIN(short) AS short, COUNT(*) AS games FROM platforms GROUP BY name "
                "ORDER BY games DESC, name")]

    def count_games(self) -> int:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games").fetchone()[0]

    def create_run(self, trigger: str, day: str, owner: str | None = None, now: datetime | None = None) -> int:
        stamp = iso(now or utcnow())
        with self.write() as c:
            cur = c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO runs(trigger, day, started_at, status, owner, heartbeat_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (trigger, day, stamp, "running", owner, stamp))
            return cur.lastrowid

    def finish_run(self, run_id: int, status: str, selected: int, ok: int, failed: int, sources: str,
                   message: str = "", now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute(
                "UPDATE runs SET finished_at=?, status=?, selected=?, ok=?, failed=?, sources=?, message=? WHERE id=?",
                (iso(now or utcnow()), status, selected, ok, failed, sources, message[:500], run_id),
            )

    def update_run_progress(self, run_id: int, selected: int, ok: int, failed: int, sources: str) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE runs SET selected=?, ok=?, failed=?, sources=?, heartbeat_at=? WHERE id=?",
                      (selected, ok, failed, sources, iso(utcnow()), run_id))

    def heartbeat_run(self, run_id: int, now: datetime | None = None) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("UPDATE runs SET heartbeat_at=? WHERE id=? AND status='running'", (iso(now or utcnow()), run_id))

    def close_stale_runs(self, now: datetime | None = None, ttl_seconds: int = 90) -> int:
        now = now or utcnow()
        threshold = iso(now - timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds))
        with self.write() as c:
            cur = c.execute(
                "UPDATE runs SET status='interrupted', finished_at=?, "
                "message=COALESCE(NULLIF(message, ''), 'Процесс остановился посреди запуска') "
                "WHERE status='running' AND COALESCE(heartbeat_at, started_at) < ?",
                (iso(now), threshold))
            return cur.rowcount

    def recent_runs(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))]

    def last_run(self) -> dict | None:
        runs = self.recent_runs(1)
        return runs[0] if runs else None

    def last_finished_at(self) -> str | None:
        with self.conn() as c:
            row = c.execute("SELECT MAX(finished_at) FROM runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL").fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

    def count_runs(self, day: str, trigger: str) -> int:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE day=? AND trigger=?", (day, trigger)).fetchone()[0]

    def add_error(self, run_id: int | None, day: str, slug: str | None, step: str, message: str) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("INSERT INTO errors(run_id, day, slug, step, message, at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                      (run_id, day, slug, step, message[:500], iso(utcnow())))

    def error_count(self, day: str | None = None) -> int:
        with self.conn() as c:
            if day:
                return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM errors WHERE day=?", (day,)).fetchone()[0]
            return c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM errors").fetchone()[0]

    def recent_errors(self, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
        with self.conn() as c:
            return [dict(r) for r in c.execute("SELECT * FROM errors ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", (limit,))]

    def prune(self, now: datetime, errors_keep_days: int, processed_keep_days: int) -> dict:
        errors_before = iso(now - timedelta(days=errors_keep_days))
        processed_before = (now - timedelta(days=processed_keep_days)).date().isoformat()
        with self.write() as c:
            e = c.execute("DELETE FROM errors WHERE at < ?", (errors_before,)).rowcount
            p = c.execute("DELETE FROM processed WHERE day < ?", (processed_before,)).rowcount
            d = c.execute("DELETE FROM day_state WHERE day < ?", (processed_before,)).rowcount
        return {"errors": e, "processed": p, "day_state": d}

    def acquire_lease(self, name: str, owner: str, ttl_seconds: int, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
        now = now or utcnow()
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute(
                "INSERT INTO leases(name, owner, acquired_at, expires_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET owner=excluded.owner, acquired_at=excluded.acquired_at, "
                "expires_at=excluded.expires_at WHERE leases.expires_at < ? OR leases.owner = excluded.owner",
                (name, owner, iso(now), iso(now + timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)), iso(now)))
            row = c.execute("SELECT owner FROM leases WHERE name=?", (name,)).fetchone()
        return bool(row) and row[0] == owner

    def renew_lease(self, name: str, owner: str, ttl_seconds: int, now: datetime | None = None) -> bool:
        now = now or utcnow()
        with self.write() as c:
            cur = c.execute("UPDATE leases SET expires_at=? WHERE name=? AND owner=?",
                            (iso(now + timedelta(seconds=ttl_seconds)), name, owner))
            return cur.rowcount == 1

    def release_lease(self, name: str, owner: str) -> None:
        with self.write() as c:
            c.execute("DELETE FROM leases WHERE name=? AND owner=?", (name, owner))

    def lease_holder(self, name: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> str | None:
        now = now or utcnow()
        with self.conn() as c:
            row = c.execute("SELECT owner FROM leases WHERE name=? AND expires_at >= ?", (name, iso(now))).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

import os
import sys


def drop_privileges(user: str, data_dir: str) -> None:
    import pwd

    pw = pwd.getpwnam(user)
    os.makedirs(data_dir, exist_ok=True)
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(data_dir):
        for name in [root] + [os.path.join(root, f) for f in files]:
            try:
                os.chown(name, pw.pw_uid, pw.pw_gid)
            except OSError:
                pass
    os.setgroups([])
    os.setgid(pw.pw_gid)
    os.setuid(pw.pw_uid)
    os.environ["HOME"] = pw.pw_dir
    os.environ["USER"] = user


def uvicorn_args(env: dict) -> list[str]:
    return [
        sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.asgi:app",
        "--host", env.get("HOST", "0.0.0.0"),
        "--port", str(env.get("PORT", "8000")),
        "--proxy-headers",
        "--forwarded-allow-ips", env.get("FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS", "*"),
        "--workers", "1",
        "--no-server-header",
    ]


def main() -> None:
    db_path = os.environ.setdefault("DB_PATH", "./data/games.db")
    run_as = os.environ.get("RUN_AS_USER", "app")
    if os.name == "posix" and os.geteuid() == 0 and run_as:
        drop_privileges(run_as, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(db_path)))
    args = uvicorn_args(os.environ)
    os.execv(args[0], args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import email.utils
import time

import httpx
import pytest

from app.http_client import HttpError, NotFound, PoliteClient, RateLimiter, retry_after_seconds


def make(handler, retries=3):
    sleeps = []
    events = []
    client = PoliteClient("UA", min_interval=0, retries=retries, transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler),
                          sleep=sleeps.append, on_request=lambda host, ok: events.append(ok))
    return client, sleeps, events


def test_429_honours_retry_after_then_succeeds():
    calls = []

    def handler(request):
        calls.append(request.url)
        if len(calls) == 1:
            return httpx.Response(429, headers={"Retry-After": "7"})
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"ok": True})

    client, sleeps, events = make(handler)
    assert client.get("https://backend.example/x").json() == {"ok": True}
    assert len(calls) == 2 and sleeps == [7.0]
    assert events == [False, True]


def test_retry_after_is_capped_and_accepts_http_dates():
    assert retry_after_seconds("3600") == 60.0
    future = email.utils.formatdate(time.time() + 20, usegmt=True)
    assert 15 <= retry_after_seconds(future) <= 21
    assert retry_after_seconds("soon") is None and retry_after_seconds(None) is None


def test_5xx_backs_off_exponentially_and_gives_up():
    calls = []

    def handler(request):
        calls.append(1)
        return httpx.Response(503)

    client, sleeps, events = make(handler, retries=3)
    with pytest.raises(HttpError, match="503"):
        client.get("https://backend.example/x")
    assert len(calls) == 4
    assert sleeps == [2.0, 4.0, 8.0]
    assert events == [False] * 4


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status,exc", [(404, NotFound), (403, HttpError), (400, HttpError)])
def test_client_errors_are_not_retried(status, exc):
    calls = []

    def handler(request):
        calls.append(1)
        return httpx.Response(status)

    client, sleeps, _ = make(handler)
    with pytest.raises(exc):
        client.get("https://backend.example/x")
    assert len(calls) == 1 and sleeps == []


def test_timeouts_are_retried():
    calls = []

    def handler(request):
        calls.append(1)
        if len(calls) < 3:
            raise httpx.ReadTimeout("slow", request=request)
        return httpx.Response(200, text="ok")

    client, sleeps, events = make(handler)
    assert client.get("https://backend.example/x").text == "ok"
    assert sleeps == [2.0, 4.0] and events == [False, False, True]


def test_timeouts_exhausted_raise_http_error():
    def handler(request):
        raise httpx.ConnectTimeout("down", request=request)

    client, sleeps, _ = make(handler, retries=1)
    with pytest.raises(HttpError, match="ConnectTimeout"):
        client.get("https://backend.example/x")
    assert sleeps == [2.0]


def test_rate_limiter_spaces_requests_per_host():
    now = [100.0]
    slept = []

    def sleep(d):
        slept.append(round(d, 3))
        now[0] += d

    limiter = RateLimiter(1.1, sleep=sleep, clock=lambda: now[0])
    limiter.wait("a")
    limiter.wait("a")
    limiter.wait("b")
    now[0] += 5
    limiter.wait("a")
    assert slept == [1.1]

import threading
from datetime import timedelta

from app.monitor import Monitor
from app.pipeline import AlreadyRunning
from app.scheduler import Scheduler, initial_next_run, interval_of

from .conftest import FakeClock


class FakePipeline:
    def __init__(self, db, clock, settings):
        self.db = db
        self.clock = clock
        self.settings = settings
        self.running = False
        self.runs = []
        self.fail_with: Exception | None = None
        self.duration = timedelta(minutes=10)

    def run(self, trigger="manual", limit=None):
        if self.fail_with:
            exc, self.fail_with = self.fail_with, None
            raise exc
        start = self.clock()
        run_id = self.db.create_run(trigger, self.settings.today(start), "test", start)
        self.clock.advance(seconds=self.duration.total_seconds())
        self.db.finish_run(run_id, "ok", 1, 1, 0, "new-releases", "", self.clock())
        self.runs.append((trigger, start))
        return {"run_id": run_id}


def make(settings, db, clock=None):
    clock = clock or FakeClock()
    settings.scheduler_enabled = True
    settings.startup_delay_seconds = 15
    settings.run_interval_minutes = 60
    pipe = FakePipeline(db, clock, settings)
    sched = Scheduler(settings, db, pipe, Monitor(), clock=clock)
    return sched, pipe, clock


def test_initial_next_run_after_restart(settings, db, clock):
    now = clock()
    assert initial_next_run(settings, db, now) == now + timedelta(seconds=settings.startup_delay_seconds)
    db.create_run("schedule", "d", "x", now - timedelta(minutes=20))
    assert initial_next_run(settings, db, now) == now + timedelta(minutes=40)
    db.create_run("schedule", "d", "x", now - timedelta(hours=3))
    with db.write() as c:
        c.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE started_at > ?", ((now - timedelta(hours=1)).isoformat(),))
    assert initial_next_run(settings, db, now) == now + timedelta(seconds=settings.startup_delay_seconds)


def test_db_with_games_but_no_runs_waits_a_full_interval(settings, db, clock):
    from .test_db import make_game

    db.upsert_game(make_game(), "x")
    assert initial_next_run(settings, db, clock()) == clock() + interval_of(settings)


def test_tick_waits_then_runs_and_schedules_from_the_run_start(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    assert sched.tick() == "wait"
    clock.advance(seconds=16)
    assert sched.tick() == "ran"
    first_start = pipe.runs[0][1]
    assert sched.next_run == first_start + timedelta(minutes=60)
    clock.advance(minutes=30)
    assert sched.tick() == "wait"
    clock.now = sched.next_run
    assert sched.tick() == "ran"
    assert len(pipe.runs) == 2 and pipe.runs[1][0] == "schedule"


def test_slot_is_not_dropped_while_another_run_is_active(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    clock.advance(seconds=16)
    sched.tick()
    clock.now = sched.next_run
    pipe.running = True
    due = sched.next_run
    assert sched.tick() == "busy"
    clock.advance(minutes=1)
    assert sched.tick() == "busy"
    assert sched.next_run == due
    pipe.running = False
    clock.advance(minutes=1)
    assert sched.tick() == "ran"
    assert len(pipe.runs) == 2


def test_manual_run_counts_as_the_slot(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    clock.advance(seconds=16)
    sched.tick()
    clock.advance(minutes=40)
    manual_start = clock()
    db.create_run("manual", settings.today(manual_start), "web", manual_start)
    assert sched.tick() == "wait"
    assert sched.next_run == manual_start + timedelta(minutes=60)


def test_another_process_taking_the_run_keeps_the_slot_due(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    clock.advance(seconds=16)
    pipe.fail_with = AlreadyRunning()
    due = sched.next_run
    assert sched.tick() == "busy"
    assert sched.next_run == due


def test_crashing_run_does_not_stop_the_scheduler(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    clock.advance(seconds=16)
    pipe.fail_with = RuntimeError("boom")
    assert sched.tick() == "crashed"
    assert "boom" in sched.last_error
    assert sched.next_run > clock()
    clock.now = sched.next_run
    assert sched.tick() == "ran"


def test_loop_survives_exceptions_in_tick(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    sched.poll_seconds = 0.01
    sched.min_wait_seconds = 0.001
    calls = []
    done = threading.Event()

    def flaky_tick(now=None):
        calls.append(1)
        if len(calls) == 1:
            raise RuntimeError("database is locked")
        if len(calls) >= 3:
            sched._stop.set()
            done.set()
        sched.next_run = clock()
        return "wait"

    sched.tick = flaky_tick
    sched.start()
    assert done.wait(5)
    sched.stop()
    assert len(calls) >= 3
    assert sched.last_error is None


def test_stale_runs_from_a_dead_process_are_closed_on_tick(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    db.create_run("schedule", "d", "dead-process", clock() - timedelta(minutes=30))
    sched.tick()
    assert db.last_run()["status"] == "interrupted"


def test_interval_is_never_below_one_minute(settings):
    settings.run_interval_minutes = 0
    assert interval_of(settings) == timedelta(minutes=1)
    settings.run_interval_minutes = -10
    assert interval_of(settings) == timedelta(minutes=1)


def test_health_reports_dead_thread_and_overdue_schedule(settings, db):
    sched, pipe, clock = make(settings, db)
    assert sched.health()["healthy"] is False
    sched._thread = threading.Thread(target=lambda: None)
    alive = threading.Event()
    sched._thread = threading.Thread(target=alive.wait, daemon=True)
    sched._thread.start()
    try:
        sched.tick()
        assert sched.health()["healthy"] is True
        clock.now = sched.next_run + timedelta(minutes=6)
        h = sched.health()
        assert h["healthy"] is False and h["overdue_seconds"] >= 360
        pipe.running = True
        assert sched.health()["healthy"] is True
    finally:
        alive.set()
    settings.scheduler_enabled = False
    assert Scheduler(settings, db, pipe, Monitor(), clock=clock).health()["healthy"] is True

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import httpx
import pytest

from app.llm import LLMClient, LLMError
from app.monitor import Monitor
from app.pipeline import AlreadyRunning, Pipeline

from .conftest import FakeClock, FakeLLM, FakeMetacritic, FakeYouTube


def make(settings, db, mc=None, yt=None, llm=None, clock=None, monitor=None):
    return Pipeline(settings, db, monitor or Monitor(), mc or FakeMetacritic(),
                    yt if yt is not None else FakeYouTube(), llm if llm is not None else FakeLLM(),
                    clock=clock or FakeClock())


def forget_today(db):
    with db.write() as c:
        c.execute("DELETE FROM processed")
        c.execute("DELETE FROM day_state")


class Killed(BaseException):
    pass


def test_first_run_processes_new_releases_and_fills_cards(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 5
    clock = FakeClock()
    p = make(settings, db, clock=clock)
    res = p.run("manual")
    assert res["status"] == "ok" and res["selected"] == 5 and res["ok"] == 5
    assert db.count_games() == 5
    day = settings.today(clock())
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 5
    g = db.get_game(slug="over-the-hill")
    assert g["critic_summary"]["method"] == "llm"
    assert g["user_summary"]["method"] == "llm"
    assert g["letsplay"]["status"] == "ok" and g["letsplay"]["method"] == "llm-transcript"
    assert g["letsplay"]["video"]["video_id"] == "bGBXM6oxbag"
    assert len(g["platforms"]) == 3
    assert g["similar"] and all(s["reasons"] for s in g["similar"])
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is False
    last = db.last_run()
    assert last["status"] == "ok" and last["finished_at"] and last["owner"] == p.owner
    assert not p.running and db.lease_holder("pipeline", clock()) is None


def test_runs_continue_into_browse_and_update_existing(settings, db):
    clock = FakeClock()
    p = make(settings, db, clock=clock)
    first = p.run()
    assert first["selected"] == 20 and first["sources"] == "new-releases"
    day = settings.today(clock())
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is True
    second = p.run()
    assert second["selected"] > 0 and "browse" in second["sources"] and "new-releases" not in second["sources"]
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 20 + second["selected"]
    third = p.run()
    assert "new-releases" not in third["sources"]
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 20 + second["selected"] + third["selected"]


def test_one_failing_game_does_not_stop_the_run(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 4
    clock = FakeClock()
    p = make(settings, db, mc=FakeMetacritic(fail_slugs={"warhammer-40000-boltgun-2"}), clock=clock)
    res = p.run()
    assert res["failed"] == 1 and res["ok"] == 3 and res["status"] == "partial"
    errors = db.recent_errors()
    assert errors[0]["slug"] == "warhammer-40000-boltgun-2" and "boom" in errors[0]["message"]


def test_failed_game_is_retried_the_same_day(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 4
    clock = FakeClock()
    mc = FakeMetacritic(fail_once={"warhammer-40000-boltgun-2"})
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock)
    assert p.run()["failed"] == 1
    day = settings.today(clock())
    second = p.run()
    assert second["sources"].startswith("retry")
    assert second["ok"] == 4 and second["failed"] == 0
    assert db.get_game(slug="warhammer-40000-boltgun-2") is not None
    with db.conn() as c:
        row = c.execute("SELECT status, attempts, source FROM processed WHERE day=? AND slug=?",
                        (day, "warhammer-40000-boltgun-2")).fetchone()
    assert tuple(row) == ("ok", 2, "new-releases")


def test_retries_are_capped(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 2
    settings.failed_game_max_attempts = 2
    clock = FakeClock()
    mc = FakeMetacritic(fail_slugs={"over-the-hill"})
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock)
    p.run()
    p.run()
    attempts = [c for c in mc.calls if c == ("game", "over-the-hill")]
    assert len(attempts) == 2
    third = p.run()
    assert "retry" not in third["sources"]
    assert len([c for c in mc.calls if c == ("game", "over-the-hill")]) == 2


def test_interrupted_run_is_recorded_and_resumed(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 5
    clock = FakeClock()
    mon = Monitor()
    mc = FakeMetacritic()
    fourth = mc.new[3].slug
    mc.raise_for[fourth] = Killed()
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock, monitor=mon)
    with pytest.raises(Killed):
        p.run()
    day = settings.today(clock())
    last = db.last_run()
    assert last["status"] == "failed" and last["finished_at"]
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 3
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is False
    assert mon.progress["run_id"] is None
    assert not p.running
    settings.batch_size = 20
    res = p.run()
    assert res["selected"] == 17
    done_first = {it.slug for it in mc.new[:3]}
    later = [slug for kind, slug in mc.calls[5:] if kind == "game"]
    assert not done_first & set(later)
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is True


def test_bookkeeping_survives_an_exception_after_the_games(settings, db, monkeypatch):
    settings.batch_size = 2
    clock = FakeClock()
    mon = Monitor()
    p = make(settings, db, clock=clock, monitor=mon)

    def broken(state):
        raise RuntimeError("disk full")

    monkeypatch.setattr(db, "save_day_state", broken)
    res = p.run()
    assert res["status"] == "failed"
    last = db.last_run()
    assert last["status"] == "failed" and last["finished_at"] and "disk full" in last["message"]
    assert mon.progress == {"run_id": None, "done": 0, "total": 0, "ok": 0, "failed": 0, "current": None,
                            "step": None, "started_at": None}
    assert mon.workers["pipeline"]["status"] == "error"
    assert not p.running
    assert any(e["step"] == "run" for e in db.recent_errors())


def test_selection_failure_is_a_failed_run_with_a_visible_error(settings, db):
    from app.http_client import SchemaError

    clock = FakeClock()
    mc = FakeMetacritic()
    mc.list_error = SchemaError("в ответе списка игр Metacritic нет массива data.items")
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock)
    res = p.run()
    assert res["status"] == "failed" and res["selected"] == 0
    err = db.recent_errors()[0]
    assert err["step"] == "selection:schema" and "data.items" in err["message"]
    assert db.get_day_state(settings.today(clock())).new_releases_done is False


def test_run_crossing_midnight_keeps_its_day_and_next_run_starts_over(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 5
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 10, 14, 20, 50, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    mc = FakeMetacritic()
    mc.on_game = lambda slug: clock.advance(minutes=3)
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock)
    p.run()
    assert clock() > datetime(2026, 10, 14, 21, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert db.processed_count("2026-10-14") == 5
    assert db.processed_count("2026-10-15") == 0
    assert db.last_run()["day"] == "2026-10-14"
    second = p.run()
    assert second["sources"] == "new-releases"
    assert db.processed_count("2026-10-15") == 5
    assert db.get_game(slug="over-the-hill")["times_processed"] == 2


def test_time_limit_stops_taking_new_games(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 6
    settings.run_max_minutes = 50
    clock = FakeClock()
    mc = FakeMetacritic()
    mc.on_game = lambda slug: clock.advance(minutes=20)
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock)
    res = p.run()
    assert res["status"] == "cut" and res["ok"] == 3
    assert "лимиту" in db.last_run()["message"]
    day = settings.today(clock())
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 3
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is False
    mc.on_game = None
    nxt = p.run()
    assert nxt["selected"] == 6 and nxt["status"] == "ok"
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 9


def test_llm_failures_trip_the_circuit_for_the_rest_of_the_run(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 4
    calls = []

    def handler(request):
        calls.append(1)
        return httpx.Response(503)

    llm = LLMClient("https://llm.example.test/v1", "m", api_key="k", min_gap=0, retries=1,

    assert len(calls) == 3

    assert g["letsplay"]["method"] == "extractive-transcript"
    llm_errors = [e for e in db.recent_errors(50) if e["step"].startswith("llm")]

    assert p.llm.circuit_open
    p.run()
    assert len(calls) > 3


def test_summaries_and_letsplay_are_reused_when_unchanged(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 1

def test_blocked_youtube_keeps_the_previous_video(settings, db):

def test_partial_metacritic_data_does_not_wipe_stored_data(settings, db):

def test_parallel_runs_are_rejected_in_process_and_across_processes(settings, db):
    clock = FakeClock()
    p = make(settings, db, clock=clock)
    p._lock.acquire()
    try:
        assert p.running
        assert p.start_background() is False
        with pytest.raises(AlreadyRunning):
            p.run()
    finally:
        p._lock.release()
    assert not p.running
    other = make(settings, db, clock=clock)
    assert db.acquire_lease("pipeline", other.owner, settings.lease_ttl_seconds, clock())
    assert p.running
    with pytest.raises(AlreadyRunning):
        p.run()
    assert db.count_games() == 0
    clock.advance(seconds=settings.lease_ttl_seconds + 1)
    assert not p.running

class PickyLLM(FakeLLM):
    def __init__(self, bad_title):
        super().__init__()
        self.bad_title = bad_title

    def chat_json(self, messages, validator=None):
        if self.bad_title in messages[-1]["content"]:
            self.calls += 1
            raise LLMError("модель отвечает мусором на эту игру")
        return super().chat_json(messages, validator)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import httpx
import pytest

from app.llm import LLMClient, LLMError
from app.monitor import Monitor
from app.pipeline import AlreadyRunning, Pipeline

from .conftest import FakeClock, FakeLLM, FakeMetacritic, FakeYouTube


def make(settings, db, mc=None, yt=None, llm=None, clock=None, monitor=None):
    return Pipeline(settings, db, monitor or Monitor(), mc or FakeMetacritic(),
                    yt if yt is not None else FakeYouTube(), llm if llm is not None else FakeLLM(),
                    clock=clock or FakeClock())


def forget_today(db):
    with db.write() as c:
        c.execute("DELETE FROM processed")
        c.execute("DELETE FROM day_state")


class Killed(BaseException):
    pass


def test_first_run_processes_new_releases_and_fills_cards(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 5
    clock = FakeClock()
    p = make(settings, db, clock=clock)
    res = p.run("manual")
    assert res["status"] == "ok" and res["selected"] == 5 and res["ok"] == 5
    assert db.count_games() == 5
    day = settings.today(clock())
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 5
    g = db.get_game(slug="over-the-hill")
    assert g["critic_summary"]["method"] == "llm"
    assert g["user_summary"]["method"] == "llm"
    assert g["letsplay"]["status"] == "ok" and g["letsplay"]["method"] == "llm-transcript"
    assert g["letsplay"]["video"]["video_id"] == "bGBXM6oxbag"
    assert len(g["platforms"]) == 3
    assert g["similar"] and all(s["reasons"] for s in g["similar"])
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is False
    last = db.last_run()
    assert last["status"] == "ok" and last["finished_at"] and last["owner"] == p.owner
    assert not p.running and db.lease_holder("pipeline", clock()) is None


def test_runs_continue_into_browse_and_update_existing(settings, db):
    clock = FakeClock()
    p = make(settings, db, clock=clock)
    first = p.run()
    assert first["selected"] == 20 and first["sources"] == "new-releases"
    day = settings.today(clock())
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is True
    second = p.run()
    assert second["selected"] > 0 and "browse" in second["sources"] and "new-releases" not in second["sources"]
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 20 + second["selected"]
    third = p.run()
    assert "new-releases" not in third["sources"]
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 20 + second["selected"] + third["selected"]


def test_one_failing_game_does_not_stop_the_run(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 4
    clock = FakeClock()
    p = make(settings, db, mc=FakeMetacritic(fail_slugs={"warhammer-40000-boltgun-2"}), clock=clock)
    res = p.run()
    assert res["failed"] == 1 and res["ok"] == 3 and res["status"] == "partial"
    errors = db.recent_errors()
    assert errors[0]["slug"] == "warhammer-40000-boltgun-2" and "boom" in errors[0]["message"]


def test_failed_game_is_retried_the_same_day(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 4
    clock = FakeClock()
    mc = FakeMetacritic(fail_once={"warhammer-40000-boltgun-2"})
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock)
    assert p.run()["failed"] == 1
    day = settings.today(clock())
    second = p.run()
    assert second["sources"].startswith("retry")
    assert second["ok"] == 4 and second["failed"] == 0
    assert db.get_game(slug="warhammer-40000-boltgun-2") is not None
    with db.conn() as c:
        row = c.execute("SELECT status, attempts, source FROM processed WHERE day=? AND slug=?",
                        (day, "warhammer-40000-boltgun-2")).fetchone()
    assert tuple(row) == ("ok", 2, "new-releases")


def test_retries_are_capped(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 2
    settings.failed_game_max_attempts = 2
    clock = FakeClock()
    mc = FakeMetacritic(fail_slugs={"over-the-hill"})
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock)
    p.run()
    p.run()
    attempts = [c for c in mc.calls if c == ("game", "over-the-hill")]
    assert len(attempts) == 2
    third = p.run()
    assert "retry" not in third["sources"]
    assert len([c for c in mc.calls if c == ("game", "over-the-hill")]) == 2


def test_interrupted_run_is_recorded_and_resumed(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 5
    clock = FakeClock()
    mon = Monitor()
    mc = FakeMetacritic()
    fourth = mc.new[3].slug
    mc.raise_for[fourth] = Killed()
    p = make(settings, db, mc=mc, clock=clock, monitor=mon)
    with pytest.raises(Killed):
        p.run()
    day = settings.today(clock())
    last = db.last_run()
    assert last["status"] == "failed" and last["finished_at"]
    assert db.processed_count(day) == 3
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is False
    assert mon.progress["run_id"] is None
    assert not p.running
    settings.batch_size = 20
    res = p.run()
    assert res["selected"] == 17
    done_first = {it.slug for it in mc.new[:3]}
    later = [slug for kind, slug in mc.calls[5:] if kind == "game"]
    assert not done_first & set(later)
    assert db.get_day_state(day).new_releases_done is True


def test_bookkeeping_survives_an_exception_after_the_games(settings, db, monkeypatch):
    settings.batch_size = 2
    clock = FakeClock()
    mon = Monitor()
    p = make(settings, db, clock=clock, monitor=mon)

    def broken(state):
        raise RuntimeError("disk full")

    monkeypatch.setattr(db, "save_day_state", broken)
    res = p.run()
    assert res["status"] == "failed"
    last = db.last_run()
    assert last["status"] == "failed" and last["finished_at"] and "disk full" in last["message"]
    assert mon.progress == {"run_id": None, "done": 0, "total": 0, "ok": 0, "failed": 0, "current": None,
                            "step": None, "started_at": None}
    assert mon.workers["pipeline"]["status"] == "error"
    assert not p.running
    assert any(e["step"] == "run" for e in db.recent_errors())


def test_selection_failure_is_a_failed_run_with_a_visible_error(settings, db):

    clock = FakeClock()

    assert db.get_day_state(settings.today(clock())).new_releases_done is False


def test_run_crossing_midnight_keeps_its_day_and_next_run_starts_over(settings, db):
    settings.batch_size = 5
    clock = FakeClock(datetime(2026, 10, 14, 20, 50, tzinfo=timezone.utc))

def test_time_limit_stops_taking_new_games(settings, db):

class PickyLLM(FakeLLM):
    def __init__(self, bad_title):
        super().__init__()
        self.bad_title = bad_title

    def chat_json(self, messages, validator=None):
        if self.bad_title in messages[-1]["content"]:
            self.calls += 1
            raise LLMError("модель отвечает мусором на эту игру")
        return super().chat_json(messages, validator)


def test_one_game_cannot_block_the_backfill(settings, db):

    clock = FakeClock()
    make(settings, db, llm=FakeLLM(fail=True), yt=FakeYouTube(transcript_ok=False), clock=clock).run()
    slugs = [it.slug for it in FakeMetacritic().new[:3]]
    titles = {s: db.get_game(slug=s)["title"] for s in slugs}
    bad = slugs[0]
    picky = PickyLLM(titles[bad])
    p = make(settings, db, llm=picky, clock=clock)
    p.backfill_llm(set(), limit=10)
    for s in slugs[1:]:
        assert db.get_game(slug=s)["critic_summary"]["method"] == "llm", s
    assert db.get_game(slug=bad)["critic_summary"]["method"] == "extractive"
    with db.conn() as c:
        attempts = c.execute("SELECT backfill_attempts FROM games WHERE slug=?", (bad,)).fetchone()[0]
    assert attempts == 1
    queue = [g["slug"] for g in db.games_with_fallbacks(10)]
    assert queue[0] == bad


def test_backfill_respects_skip_ids_limit_and_deadline(settings, db):

    assert up.backfill_llm(set(), limit=2) == 2
    skip = {db.get_game(slug=s)["id"] for s in [it.slug for it in FakeMetacritic().new[:3]]}
    assert up.backfill_llm(skip, limit=5) == 0

import os
import sys

from app import serve


def test_uvicorn_args_take_port_from_env_and_trust_the_proxy():
    args = serve.uvicorn_args({"PORT": "4321"})
    assert args[:4] == [sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.asgi:app"]
    assert args[args.index("--port") + 1] == "4321"
    assert args[args.index("--forwarded-allow-ips") + 1] == "*"
    assert "--proxy-headers" in args
    assert args[args.index("--workers") + 1] == "1"
    assert "--reload" not in args
    assert serve.uvicorn_args({})[serve.uvicorn_args({}).index("--port") + 1] == "8000"


def test_main_sets_db_default_and_execs_without_root(monkeypatch):
    seen = {}
    monkeypatch.delenv("DB_PATH", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setenv("PORT", "9100")
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "geteuid", lambda: 1000)
    monkeypatch.setattr(serve, "drop_privileges", lambda *a: seen.setdefault("dropped", a))
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "execv", lambda path, args: seen.update(path=path, args=args))
    serve.main()
    assert os.environ["DB_PATH"] == "./data/games.db"
    assert "dropped" not in seen
    assert seen["args"][seen["args"].index("--port") + 1] == "9100"


def test_main_drops_root_to_the_app_user(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    seen = {}
    monkeypatch.setenv("DB_PATH", str(tmp_path / "data" / "games.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("RUN_AS_USER", "app")
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "geteuid", lambda: 0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(serve, "drop_privileges", lambda user, data_dir: seen.update(user=user, data_dir=data_dir))
    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "execv", lambda path, args: seen.update(args=args))
    serve.main()
    assert seen["user"] == "app" and seen["data_dir"] == str(tmp_path / "data")
    assert "args" in seen
